llms.body:
# TomTom

> Location intelligence that grounds AI in reality.

TomTom interprets global mobility, transforming billions of real-world movements into location intelligence that grounds AI in reality. It gives people, machines and agentic systems the context to understand the world, make safe decisions and act with confidence.

Builders and developers use TomTom’s technology to create machine learning workflows, geospatial analytics and location-aware applications across automotive, insurtech, public sector, on-demand and logistics. With TomTom, innovators can bring location intelligence into production faster, build smarter and be ready for what’s next.

Headquartered in Amsterdam, with over 3,000 employees around the globe and more than three decades of technology expertise, TomTom provides the location intelligence that moves the world.

## Products
TomTom’s products offer reliable mapping and location-based services for all your business needs: https://www.tomtom.com/products/

### Encode
Encode is the translation layer between our data and agentic systems, turning prompts into accurate answers by making our data understandable to machines and agents.
- [Location Embeddings](https://www.tomtom.com/products/#encode): Labels, tokens, graphs and numbers that turn our maps into math or a language that AI understands.
- [Location Ontology](https://www.tomtom.com/products/#encode): Shared vocabulary that relates road, lane, place and traffic, so APIs, models and agents interpret location data the same way, every time.
- [TomTom Orbis Maps](https://www.tomtom.com/tomtom-orbis-maps/): Global, interoperable maps combining proprietary, open and your own data for accurate, immersive experiences.
- [Orbis Maps for Automated Driving](https://www.tomtom.com/products/orbis-maps-for-automated-driving/): Integrate immersive, rich, 3D lane-level maps with up-to-the-minute freshness.
- [Traffic Stats](https://www.tomtom.com/products/traffic-stats/): Access historical data on road speeds, travel times and traffic density.
- [Historical Traffic Volumes](https://www.tomtom.com/products/historical-traffic-volumes/): Analyze traffic volumes with accurate, scalable data in an instant.
- [RoadCheck](https://www.tomtom.com/products/roadcheck/): Industry-first tool for when, where and under what conditions automated driving can be activated.

### Grounding
Give your innovations and ideas real-world context through our MCPs and APIs. TomTom location intelligence grounds your systems in reality.
- [Maps MCP Server](https://docs.tomtom.com/tomtom-maps-mcp/documentation/overview): Bring global, accurate and always fresh maps into your solutions through our Maps MCP connector.
- [Map Display API](https://www.tomtom.com/products/map-display-api/): Build mapping experiences that make your app stand out.
- [TomTom Satellite Imagery](https://www.tomtom.com/products/satellite-imagery/): A photorealistic layer that captures the earth’s surface in vivid detail.
- [Global Entity Matcher](https://www.tomtom.com/products/tomtom-gem/): Simplify data exchange and geospatial data management.
- [Snap to Roads API](https://docs.tomtom.com/snap-to-roads-api/documentation/product-information/introduction): Match GPS traces to the right road sections for cleaner analytics and machine learning data.
- [Routing APIs](https://www.tomtom.com/products/routing-apis/): Enrich navigation apps with precise directions and powerful route planning.
- [Unified Speed Restrictions](https://www.tomtom.com/products/unified-speed-restrictions/): TomTom’s most advanced speed information service.
- [Hazard Warnings](https://www.tomtom.com/products/hazard-warnings/): Real-time alerts show what’s happening and how to avoid it.
- [EV Data Service](https://www.tomtom.com/products/ev-data-service/): Complete, accurate charging station data with real-time availability.
- [Places APIs](https://www.tomtom.com/products/places-apis/): Take location to new levels with advanced search, geocoding and more.
- [Parking Services](https://www.tomtom.com/products/on-street-and-off-street-parking/): Real-time parking info reduces parking stress.
- [Fuel Services](https://www.tomtom.com/products/fuel-services/): Real-time info on fuel prices and stations.
- [TomTom Traffic](https://www.tomtom.com/tomtom-traffic/): Real-time traffic data and advanced road analytics to optimize traffic management and operational efficiency.
- [Traffic Analytics MCP Server](https://docs.tomtom.com/tomtom-traffic-analytics-mcp/documentation/overview): Predict with accuracy and plan with precision by accessing world-leading traffic data through our MCP.
- [Traffic APIs](https://www.tomtom.com/products/traffic-apis/): Integrate traffic data to reduce time, emissions and stress on the road.
- [Traffic Stats](https://www.tomtom.com/products/traffic-stats/): Access historical data on road speeds, travel times and traffic density.
- [Historical Traffic Volumes](https://www.tomtom.com/products/historical-traffic-volumes/): Analyze traffic volumes with accurate, scalable data in an instant.
- [Origin Destination Analysis](https://www.tomtom.com/products/origin-destination-matrix-analysis/): Analyze trip patterns and drivers’ preferred routes.
- [Route Monitoring](https://www.tomtom.com/products/route-monitoring/): Track traffic on key routes and share live info with road users.
- [Area Analytics](https://www.tomtom.com/products/area-analytics/): Get traffic insights for custom areas and timeframes.
- [Junction Analytics](https://www.tomtom.com/products/junction-analytics/): Monitor and improve the performance of your traffic light network.

### Studio
Adapt, render and create human-centered experiences, from voice inputs to 3D visualizations and graphic maps, with our SDKs and tools.
- [Maps SDK for JavaScript](https://www.tomtom.com/products/maps-sdk-for-javascript/): Add location services to your apps with customizable maps, advanced routing, and easy integration.
- [Navigation SDK for mobile](https://www.tomtom.com/products/navigation-sdk-for-mobile/): Build navigation apps with optimized routing, accurate ETAs and real-time traffic.
- [Automotive Navigation](https://www.tomtom.com/products/automotive-navigation/): Enhance the in-vehicle experience with configurable, quick-to-integrate navigation.
- [ADAS SDK](https://www.tomtom.com/products/adas-sdk/): Know what lies ahead with up-to-the-minute ADAS map info.
- [TomTom MOVE](https://www.tomtom.com/products/tomtom-move/): Ready-to-use reports and data visualizations from our traffic analytics tools.
- [Map Maker](https://www.tomtom.com/products/map-maker/): Create custom maps with our new visualization tool.
- [Figma TomTom Maps Generator](https://www.figma.com/community/plugin/1316378980458531468/tomtom-maps-generator): Import TomTom or custom map styles directly into Figma.

### For drivers
Apps and sat navs with live traffic, fresh maps and more.
- [Navigation apps](https://www.tomtom.com/navigation/mobile-apps/): TomTom navigation on your phone.
- [Personal and professional sat navs](https://www.tomtom.com/navigation/gps/): See the full range of TomTom GPS sat navs.
- [In-dash navigation](https://www.tomtom.com/in-dash-navigation/): Everything you need to optimize your in-car navigation.
- [Accessories](https://www.tomtom.com/navigation/accessories/): Chargers, cables and protections for your navigation devices.
- [Support](https://help.tomtom.com/hc/): Need help or have questions? We are here to guide you.

## Solutions
### Industries
- [Fleet management and logistics](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/fleet-management-logistics/): Build and optimize your operations
- [Mobility on demand](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/mobility-on-demand/): Accurate travel times for on-time operations
- [Government and public sector](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/government-and-public-sector/): Smarter decisions for infrastructure and transportation networks
- [Insurtech](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/insurtech/): Price risk and validate claims with real-world context
- [Retail and advertising](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/retail-and-advertising/): Find the best location for your business requirement
- [Defense and government](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/defense-and-government/): Real-world information for high stake decisions

### Use cases
- [Traffic and mobility intelligence](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/traffic-and-mobility-intelligence/): Unmatched live and historic data to plan and predict
- [Location analytics](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/location-analytics/): Make data informed decisions
- [EV experience](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/ev-experience/): Routing that considers charge, range and destination
- [Automated Driving](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/automated-driving/): Maps and ADAS solutions for all levels of driving
- [Navigation for Automotive](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/navigation-for-automotive/): Create in-vehicle experiences that drivers demand
- [Safety and regulations](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/safety-and-regulations/): Meet speed, safety and compliance requirements
- [Territory risk assessment for auto insurance](https://www.tomtom.com/solutions/territory-risk-assessment-for-auto-insurance/): Assess risk by census tract, ZIP code or road segment

## Developers
- [Maps](https://docs.tomtom.com/#Maps): Reference and guides for rendering, styling and serving TomTom maps.
- [Navigation](https://docs.tomtom.com/#Navigation): Reference and guides for routing, matrices and turn-by-turn directions.
- [Places](https://docs.tomtom.com/#Places): Reference and guides for search, geocoding and points of interest.
- [Traffic](https://docs.tomtom.com/#Traffic): Reference and guides for live flow, incidents and historical traffic.
- [All Documentation](https://docs.tomtom.com/): Every API reference, guide and tutorial in one place.
- [Demo Hub](https://www.tomtom.com/demo-hub/): Explore real-world use cases through interactive demos.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/tomtom-international/): Code snippets, repositories and examples.
- [Technical Support](https://support.tomtom.com/support): Find API and SDK documentation and tutorials.
- [API Explorer](https://docs.tomtom.com/api-explorer-index/documentation/product-information/introduction): Test any TomTom API and tweak parameters without writing code.
- [Start building for free](https://my.tomtom.com/): Sign up for a free evaluation and start testing TomTom APIs right away. No credit card required.
- [Pricing](https://docs.tomtom.com/pricing): Build with the world's smartest map. Pay only as you grow.

## Resources
### Learn
- [Newsroom](https://www.tomtom.com/newsroom/): Announcements, blog, product news and press material
- [Press releases](https://www.tomtom.com/newsroom/press-releases/): Official statements and financial announcements
- [Customers](https://www.tomtom.com/customers/): Why our customers choose to work with us

### Engage
- [Events](https://www.tomtom.com/events/): Where to meet the TomTom team, in person and online
- [Webinars](https://www.tomtom.com/events/webinar/): Recorded and upcoming sessions about our industries and products
- [Demo Hub](https://www.tomtom.com/demo-hub/): Explore real-world use cases through interactive demos


## Company
### Company info
- [About us](https://www.tomtom.com/company/): Who TomTom is, what we build and where we are going
- [Boards and committees](https://www.tomtom.com/company/boards-and-committees/): The management board, the supervisory board and their committees
- [Investors](https://corporate.tomtom.com/investors/overview/): Results, reports and everything the market needs from TomTom

### Join us
- [Careers](https://www.tomtom.com/careers/): What it is like to work here, and how we hire
- [Jobs](https://www.tomtom.com/careers/joboverview/): Every open role across engineering, product and the wider company
- [Benefits](https://www.tomtom.com/careers/benefits/): What TomTom offers beyond the role itself

### Impact
- [Sustainability](https://www.tomtom.com/company/sustainability/): Climate targets and progress against them
- [Privacy](https://www.tomtom.com/company/privacy/): How TomTom handles personal data and the choices available to users
- [Quality](https://www.tomtom.com/company/quality-policy/): The quality policy behind the products and the data
